highlights.match: Blockchain-federated-learning and deep learning models for covid-19
highlights.summary: A capsule-network model that segments and classifies COVID-19 in CT scans. Hospitals train it together through blockchain-based federated learning, without pooling patient data.
highlights.figure: Fig. 1: Capsule-based (SegCaps) segmentation and classification model

highlights.summary: A survey that organizes explainable intrusion detection into white-box and black-box families, and proposes an architecture for designing an X-IDS.
A survey of how explainable and interpretable ML are used for anomaly detection, fault diagnosis, and prognosis in predictive maintenance.
